name: Template - error (404 / 500)
purpose: The page a person lands on when the address is wrong (404) or something failed at our end (500). It composes Confirmation's centred column and Empty-state's decorative glyph at page scale, and its whole design argument is what it does NOT do: it binds no RAG colour and it invents no support semantics.
$provenance-note: NEW at #210 (wave 6, lane B) against the Layer-2 P3 fan-out brief - itinerary row 111. PROPOSED, NOT RULED. Layer-2 rows have no ruled artefact form; this file ships in the library's grammar on the brief's PROPOSED convention (s182-D2, the Kpi-tile precedent). No registration was performed: no CATEGORIES entry, no MIGRATED_SNIPPETS entry, no component-types.json membership, no canon.css block, no _rulings.json line, no gen_kg_edges.py run, no git operation. Deleting this pair costs nothing because nothing points at it.
$layer-note: The wave-5 and wave-6 briefs PROPOSED the meta key `layer`. meta.schema.json is additionalProperties:false with patternProperties '^\\$' only, so a bare `layer` key FAILS probe P-1 (probe_meta_schema.py). `$layer` is the legal form and is what is used here - the correction #210 wave-5 lane C reported, carried forward, not re-discovered. A `$`-prefixed key is an ANNOTATION by the schema's own grammar: if Layer-2 membership is meant to be queryable structure it wants a real enum property and a schema amendment. Still open, still Dave's.

props.name: variant
props.$note: 404's primary action is the way back to something that exists. 500's primary action is to try the same thing again, because that is the only move the person can make.

props.name: referenceCode
props.$note: Shown as neutral text. NOTHING is claimed about what it is for.

variants.use: The address is wrong. 'We cannot find that page' + 'Nothing on your account has been affected.'
Something failed at our end. 'This was not caused by anything you did, and no payment or instruction was submitted.'

tokens.buttons: the button/primary/* and button/tertiary/* Mono ladder
tokens.$noRag: ⛔ NOT ONE rag/* TOKEN IS BOUND IN THIS FILE, AND THAT IS THE DESIGN DECISION. A form error names a field the person can fix and the red carries that instruction; a 404 has no field. Painting a whole page with the error seat is a POLICY decision sitting in the two-red law's neighbourhood (s151-D1) and in the mono error-ink camp's (s149-D1), and it is Dave's. The heading carries the meaning.
tokens.$mono: MONO ONLY. No colour value is invented anywhere in this template. Every hex in both theme blocks appears in the theme block of a source component. The two-red law (s151-D1) and the mono error-ink camp (s149-D1) are untouched.
tokens.$noNewWidths: s210-D3 discipline: the template asserts page-scale layout only. No molecule inside it receives a new fixed width.

livesInside: Nothing - an error page is often served OUTSIDE the app shell
App shell (top nav), when the route is known

$composes: Confirmation (.confirm, .confirm__title, .confirm__msg, .confirm__actions - its raw font declarations dropped and its own .confirm .btn ladder NOT carried, because this page uses the Button ATOM and two ladders fork it; its ENTRANCE ANIMATION is also not carried, because an error page that animates in is a page celebrating a failure), Empty-state (.empty .glyph, re-selected as .glyph, declaration-identical), Button (both actions, with its injected press-physics partial), Layout-utilities (.l-container / .l-row).

accessibility.roles: No invented roles. Each specimen is a <main> whose message column is role="group" with aria-labelledby pointing at the <h1>.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab order follows source order: the way home, the primary action, the secondary action. Three stops, which is the whole page.
accessibility.announcements: None. An error PAGE is a destination, not an event: the person arrived here, so there is nothing to announce that the heading does not already say.
accessibility.targets: MEASURED at 1400px: 220x44, 234x44, 169x44, 198x44. Every action clears 44px in both directions.
accessibility.$colourIsNeverAlone: Nothing on this page carries meaning by colour at all - there is no colour on it beyond ink and the button ladder. The glyph is aria-hidden decoration.
accessibility.$copyFence: ⛔ NO INVENTED SUPPORT SEMANTICS, to the letter of the brief's do-not-rule list: no phone number, no chat link, no 'contact us', no promise that anyone is looking, and no service-status claim. A neutral reference code is shown and nothing is asserted about it.

antiPatterns: Painting the page with rag/error. See tokens.$noRag - it is a policy decision and it is Dave's.
Inventing a support route. A template must not mint a channel the product may not have.
Blaming the person. Both variants say plainly that nothing on the account was affected and nothing was submitted.
Animating the entrance. Confirmation's pop is carried by the confirmation template and deliberately NOT by this one.
Reusing status-icons/error-solid.svg without opening it. It is an EMPTY FILE - an <svg> element with no path inside it. Reported to the conductor as a library finding; not repaired by this lane.
Letting the column hold Confirmation's 380px. An error page's body copy is a sentence, not a receipt line; the CONTAINER widens it to 520px and asserts nothing about any molecule.

Headless Chromium from file:// with the real HSBC cut (canvas-width assertion against TWO controls: target 346.88, both aliases 346.88, DejaVu 375.39, nonexistent face 301.07), light AND dark, at 1400 / 820 / 420 CSS px, screenshots LOOKED AT. Zero horizontal page overflow in all 6 runs. Collapse MEASURED: .confirm__actions flex-direction read row -> row -> column at 1400 / 820 / 420. ONE DEFECT FOUND BY THE DANGLING-VAR PROBE AND IT WAS INVISIBLE: Confirmation's .confirm__msg reads color:var(--muted), and --muted was NOT declared in the first draft's theme blocks. The declaration was invalid at computed-value time and the message simply INHERITED text/default - which in Mono is the SAME HEX as text/secondary, so the page rendered identically and nothing visual could ever have shown it. Declared and bound; re-measured to zero dangling.
